title: Agent Academy
premise: A secret school for junior agents: codes, safes, gadgets, rival cadets and a mole somewhere in the class.

companion.name: CHIP
companion.about: a color-changing gecko who talks through Ozzie's translator collar, dry and sarcastic

cast.IVY: codebreaker; calm, precise, a little bossy
cast.OZZIE: gadget kid; over-engineers everything, always has a tool
cast.TEO: rookie; jumps to answers, says "that's classified" about everything
cast.VALE: rival cadet; smug, quick, usually half right

gag: Teo says "that's classified" about things that are not classified.

fragments.style: Middle-grade graphic novel panel, clean cel-shaded coloring, bold black ink outlines, rounded cartoon characters with big expressive faces, rich saturated colors, steel blue, cyan and warm yellow palette
fragments.notext: Wordless art, all surfaces blank, no lettering, no numbers, no speech bubbles, one single continuous scene filling the whole image with no panel borders, frames, bands or split sections
fragments.ivy: a girl age 11 with brown skin, a long black braid, round glasses and a mustard yellow jacket
fragments.ozzie: a boy age 11 with light skin, freckles, messy red hair, a green hoodie and a utility belt of gadgets
fragments.farah: a girl age 11 with olive skin, a black bob haircut with a red headband, and a black field vest over a white shirt
fragments.teo: a boy age 11 with dark brown skin, short curly black hair and a navy track jacket
fragments.chip: a small bright green gecko with a glowing cyan stripe down its back and a tiny silver collar
fragments.vale: a girl age 12 with pale skin, a silver-blonde ponytail and a black and silver cadet uniform, smug smile
fragments.academy: a sleek underground spy academy with steel walls, cyan light strips and blank wall screens
